- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model often underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% for next 3–5 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 75% of recent 18-day high), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above recent peak for next 5 days.  
- If true outcome shows mean reversion (price drops 5%+ from recent peak within 5 days), model often fails to correct; apply downward bias of 1–2% for next 3–7 days.  
- If sentiment shifts from positive to negative within 3 days, model often lags; adjust forecast 1–2 days ahead to reflect sentiment reversal.  
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently overestimates early in the forecast window; reduce first 5–7 days by 1–2% to align with observed decay.
